cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then this is your training opportunity.

mechanism: A tries to return wrongly assumed cleaning duty while retaining a supervisor posture by accepting B conditions for taking the mop.
confusable: Unlike general laziness, A must identify duty as B responsibility; unlike firm delegation, A gives practical support to keep B accepting it.
comparison: A rota and hands-on training bargain differ from a neighbor reminder-group handover.
seedUse: Use canonical D29-a rota/mop training chain and S02-b adapting the method to keep a participant cooperating.
